ABOUT TECHNEXT
An Odoo partner that plugs into
your system.
TechNext Pte. Ltd. is a Singapore-based Odoo Ready Partner. For
Philippine companies we lead with Odoo, set up by our own experts for
BIR requirements: e-invoicing planning, CAS or CBA books, 2307s and
alphalists. We are an affordable, SME-friendly Odoo partner: you keep the
company system you run today (QuickBooks, Xero, SAP Business One,
Excel or an in-house tool) and we plug Odoo in beside it for accounting
and the BIR books and forms. We also implement Odoo ERP end to end.
Every project starts with a fixed, written quote, so there is no need to
replace your current system.
Sales, discovery and on-site work run from our Singapore headquarters. Odoo
configuration, custom modules and integrations are built at our main development
and consulting hub in Taguig City, Metro Manila, and our Ho Chi Minh City hub
supports the engineering work. One project, one team, and the same people after
go-live.

QUESTIONS CLIENTS ASK
QAre we covered?
Covered now: e-commerce sellers above micro, LTS accounts, large taxpayers and
CAS or CBA users. Micro taxpayers are exempt.
QIsn't a PDF invoice enough?
No. Under RMC 98-2026, a system that only prints invoices is not e-invoicing.
QIs Odoo BIR-accredited?
No software is. The BIR has accredited no e-invoicing provider (advisory, 14 Sep
2026).
Coverage check with your accountant: covered now, later or exempt
Invoice flow map: invoices, credit notes, branches and anything issued by hand
EIS route, scoped with you: Odoo has no built-in connection to the BIR's EIS,

No-edit flows: credit notes for decreases, new e-invoices for increases
Downtime plan: a manual invoice, later replaced by an e-invoice
PTI papers: you apply; we prepare the process flow and sample invoices from
